doc: Named code versions for tools/eval/metrics.py --group-by version / family (docs/eval.md section 2). A run belongs to the last entry whose commit is an ancestor of (or equal to) the run's code commit (runs.jsonl `code`, `+dirty` stripped); runs older than the first entry are 'before <first name>'. Keep the entries in time order; give each the decision-log line (or tag) that says when it went live. An entry whose commit is null is announced but not live: it is skipped until its commit is filled in (V4: fill in its first playing commit when it goes live, docs/v4-go-live.md). The brain setup of a run (engines, models, knowledge prefix) is not a version: it is in logs/run-config.jsonl, see metrics.py --group-by config.
